title: JSFL: tl.layerCount property missing from JsflTimeline
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the JsflTimeline interface (line 403+) has frameCount (line 407) and layers array (line 408) but lacks a layerCount property. Flash 8 JSFL uses tl.layerCount to get the number of layers. Fix: add 'readonly layerCount: number' to the JsflTimeline interface, and add a getter in makeTimelineProxy() that returns the layers array length (equivalent to tl.layers.length). 2-3 lines total.
